name: Personnel records remain private to their owner and support full CRUD
steps: Sign in as User A
Create a personnel record
Refresh the app
Edit the record
Delete the record and confirm
expected: The record survives refresh, edits persist, mobile fields remain usable, and confirmed deletion removes only the owner record.

name: Offline 1405 salary calculation follows rank, education, service, attendance and tax rules
description: Verifies the offline payroll calculator uses the requested 1405 Solar calendar, exact supplied rank salaries, automatic allowance rules, attendance-specific deductions, and the fixed 150 AFN bank salary-transfer deduction.
steps: Open 'معاشاتو معلومات' while offline
Select مالي کال ۱۴۰۵, choose حمل and verify 31 days, then میزان 30 days and حوت 29 days
Choose نظامي and select جګړن / سمونیار and verify the automatic salary is 16150
Choose ماستر and verify the automatic education allowance is 1100
Enter 12 service years and verify the automatic service allowance is 1100
Keep حاضر selected and verify feeding allowance is 150 multiplied by every day of the selected month
Choose رخصت and enter 5 days, then verify only 5 days of feeding are removed
Choose غیرحاضر and enter 5 days, then verify 5 days of salary and all allowances are removed proportionally
Verify the first 10000 is exempt, only the excess up to 100000 is taxed at 10%, and the excess above 100000 is taxed progressively at 15%
Verify the table shows a separate 150 AFN bank transfer deduction immediately after tax and the final net amount subtracts both tax and the bank deduction
Verify the complete calculation appears without horizontal page/table scrolling on mobile
expected: Month lengths are automatic for 1405; rank selection immediately supplies the exact salary; education and service allowances are automatic; leave/sick/course Kabul reduce only feeding for their written days; nonattendance reduces salary and all allowances for those days; tax follows 0%, 10% and 15% thresholds; the twelve requested table columns remain fully usable on a mobile screen, with the 150 AFN bank transfer deduction in column 11 immediately after tax and before the final net amount.

name: All payroll and finance dates are Solar Hijri 1405
description: Verifies user-facing dates and payroll months use Solar Hijri 1405, with Gregorian representation kept internal where backend validation requires it.
steps: Open the Payroll section and create a record
Verify the month selector shows only 1405 months
Open Transactions and create a record
Verify the date field uses a 1405 Solar date such as 1405/07/08
Open Reports and verify the report date is Solar 1405
Open Audit and Ledger and verify displayed dates are Solar
expected: Payroll month and finance date entry/display are Solar Hijri 1405 throughout the user interface and reports.

name: Persistent sign-in exit locks the device without signing out
description: Verifies system exit keeps the account session and return requires local device verification.
steps: Sign in as Account A
Open the sidebar and choose the system-exit action
Confirm the exit
Reopen the app
Unlock with fingerprint/PIN
Verify Account A opens without email login
Use the separate account-switch action
expected: System exit never signs out the account; return uses device verification, while explicit account switching signs out only after confirmation.

name: Safe refresh and color controls remain available
description: Verifies safe refresh, appearance controls and app-only display behavior remain available.
steps: Open the sidebar and tap 'معلومات تازه کول'
Open Settings
Choose a color preset
Refresh the app
Return to Settings
expected: The app refreshes without signing out, the chosen appearance remains available, and no embedded third-party frame or advertising surface is exposed by the application.
